company.name: ZEEBU
company.shortDescription: The world’s first B2B loyalty token for telecom carriers
company.description: Zeebu is the world’s first on-chain invoice settlement platform, specifically designed for the Telecom Carrier industry. Powered by the ZBU Loyalty token, the platform incentivizes and rewards telecom carriers for successful invoice settlements. By utilizing cutting-edge blockchain technology and smart contracts, Zeebu provides a secure and compliant platform that streamlines invoice settlements, facilitates instant global transactions, and enhances efficiency. This fosters trust and transparency within the industry, enabling telecom carriers to transact with ease and confidence.

productsAndServices.description: A blockchain-based payment and settlement platform designed for telecom carriers to enable instant, secure, and compliant global invoice settlements.
productsAndServices.name: Zeebu Web3 Neobank for Telecom Settlements

productsAndServices.description: A blockchain-based loyalty and settlement token used by telecom carriers to facilitate and reward invoice settlements within the Zeebu ecosystem.
productsAndServices.name: ZBU Token Loyalty and Settlement Token

productsAndServices.description: A scalable backend system that tracks and processes telecom invoice settlements using blockchain and smart contracts for real-time transaction finality.
productsAndServices.name: Zeebu On-Chain Invoice Settlement Module

productsAndServices.description: A technology layer providing secure wallets, exchange gateways, KYC/AML compliance, and invoice settlement services for telecom payment processing.
productsAndServices.name: Zeebu Payment Service Provider (PSP) Layer

productsAndServices.description: A decentralized governance framework enabling token holders to participate in decision-making, staking, and network validation within the Zeebu ecosystem.
productsAndServices.name: Zeebu Decentralized Governance Protocol (ZBU Protocol)

productsAndServices.description: A liquidity provision system that supports real-time, high-volume telecom settlements by incentivizing liquidity providers within the Zeebu network.
productsAndServices.name: Zeebu On-Chain Liquidity Protocol
